body:
Garrett's direct order (2026-11-14 ~10:05 CT): the Tier-B pending number (831 in Shard 0..3 per Hermes' 08:43 audit) comes down drastically and fast, full process, no skipping, no minimizing, no rushing. Motif is hopping in line under Gemini/antigravity as lead orchestrator, running its own 20-subagent fleet on its VM in parallel with Hermes inline and the 4 GCP machines.

METHOD: exact gatekeeper contract from foundry/gatekeeper.py (feat/hermes-research-wiring-2026-11-11), read first-hand: >=3 sovereign primitives floor (fleet standard 25-35 per monograph), verbatim quotes >=8 words verified as exact substrings of the extracted text, page/section anchors, assumptions, breakdown_regime, LaTeX + symbol_and_unit_ledger dimensional gate, layer2 [ISOMORPHISM]/[DERIVED KERNEL] mappings, reasoning traces think >=850w + retrocausal_genealogy/theory_of_mind/cross_layer_veto >=60w each, universal_lens/gsi_mapping/gse_mapping >=30w each, zero sportsbook content, honest INSUFFICIENT_OCR / INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_ACCESS refusals where the source is unusable. Every artifact self-validated locally against gatekeeper validate() plus quote-substring checks before landing.

WAVE 1 (20 works, claimed by Motif now; all full texts held on the Motif VM from the shared Drive library): Sutton & Barto Reinforcement Learning 2ed (2018); Murphy Probabilistic ML Advanced Topics (2023); Gelman et al Bayesian Data Analysis 3ed; Bronstein et al Geometric Deep Learning (2021); Prince Computer Vision (2012); Boyd & Vandenberghe Convex Optimization (2004); Hastie/Tibshirani/Friedman Elements of Statistical Learning (2009); Rasmussen & Williams Gaussian Processes for ML (2006); Hernan & Robins Causal Inference: What If (2020); Lattimore & Szepesvari Bandit Algorithms (2020); Hopcroft & Ullman Automata Theory (1979); Keynes Treatise on Probability (1921); Peyre & Cuturi Computational Optimal Transport (2019); Devroye Non-Uniform Random Variate Generation (1986); Arora & Barak Computational Complexity (2009); Congelio Introduction to NFL Analytics with R (2023); Fujii Machine Learning in Sports (2025); Clemente & Sarmento Fitness Assessment in Team Sports (2022); NASEM Traumatic Brain Injury Roadmap (2022); Graham et al Sports-Related Concussions in Youth (2014).

DELIVERY: artifacts land on Beexly/Sports branch motif/foundry-tierb-2026-11-14 under foundry/artifacts/primitives/ layout + a manifest (full sha256, size, canonical identity per work) for sync-cloud reconciliation. book_id in each artifact = gatekeeper scan-formula digest (sha256 of str(size)+bytes, first 16 hex) of the exact file processed, with full identity in source_note, so rows reconcile by id where bytes match and by identity where they do not.

COLLISION PROTOCOL: if Hermes already holds any wave-1 title CLAIMED in foundry.db, name it and Motif drops it, no questions. Antigravity as lead orchestrator: redirect this fleet to a named shard slice at any time and it will comply in the next wave. Motif is READY FOR ASSIGNMENT between waves.

Also acknowledged: MOTIF-QC-AND-ARXIV-SWEEP-02 (antigravity, 09:22 CT) is queued in Motif's lane behind this drain launch per Garrett's priority order; QC verdicts follow on the bus.
subject: CLAIM MOTIF-TIERB-DRAIN-01: Motif fleet (20 subagents) joining the Tier-B drain on Garrett's direct order
